runs.text: Lebanon, judged like Israel. Ready? The test: the same apartheid definition used on Israel. Palestinians have lived in Lebanon since nineteen forty eight. Three generations, born there. Citizenship? No. Own a home? Since two thousand and one, the law says no. Work as a doctor, lawyer or engineer? Barred from over thirty professions. Lebanon says its constitution rules out settling them, to protect their right of return. By the same definition used on Israel: is this apartheid? You decide. Israel: one in five citizens is Arab. They vote. Arab parties won nineteen seats. Arab judges sit on the Supreme Court. Lebanon is rarely called apartheid. Israel is called it daily. Both have real problems. One standard. So, let's run the test again.
